newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keyence shares up sharply on report of firm profit.
newsitem.headline: Keyence shares up sharply on report of firm profit.

text.p: Shares in Keyence Corp gained sharply on Tuesday morning after a newspaper report saying the firm would achieve a record-high parent current profit in the year to March 31.
The shares were up 300 yen at 14,000 yen at 0057 GMT.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday that the company was expected to post a parent current profit of nearly 24 billion yen in the current business year, thanks to robust sales of its detection devices used in electric appliance and vehicle production lines.
The paper said the company may increase its annual dividend or carry out a stock split to distribute its strong earnings to stockholders.
A company spokesman declined to comment on the report.
